timeline.description: Check into Circa Resort & Casino on Fremont Street — the newest downtown tower with the world's largest sportsbook.

timeline.description: Hit the rooftop Stadium Swim — a 6-level pool amphitheater with a 40-foot LED screen. Then check out the world's largest sportsbook downstairs.

timeline.description: Dinner at Bacchanal Buffet or the Forum Shops food court — one of the best buffets in Vegas.

timeline.title: Bellagio Fountains
timeline.description: Catch the iconic Bellagio Fountains show — choreographed water, music, and light on an 8-acre lake. Runs every 15 min in the evening.

timeline.title: Fremont Street Experience
timeline.description: Head back to Fremont Street — the Viva Vision LED canopy light show, live bands, and old-school Vegas atmosphere right outside Circa.

summary: Full day on the Strip — casino walk, High Roller, pool time, and an optional evening show.

stay.name: Circa Resort & Casino

timeline.title: Late Breakfast at Circa
timeline.description: Sleep in and fuel up at Saginaw's Delicatessen inside Circa — massive portions and classic deli fare.

timeline.title: Explore the Strip Casinos
timeline.description: Uber to the Strip and walk through The Venetian (Grand Canal Shoppes), Bellagio (Conservatory & Botanical Gardens), and Caesars Palace (Forum Shops). 2–2.5 hours.

timeline.title: High Roller
timeline.description: Ride the High Roller observation wheel for panoramic views of the Strip and desert — 45–60 min.

timeline.title: Stadium Swim at Circa
timeline.description: Hit the rooftop pool amphitheater — 6 levels, cabanas, and a massive screen. The signature Circa experience.

timeline.title: Casino & Cocktails at Circa
timeline.description: Try your luck at Circa's casino floor, then grab cocktails at the Legacy Club rooftop bar — 60th-floor views of the entire Strip.

timeline.title: Fremont Street Experience
timeline.description: Walk the Fremont Street Experience — the world's largest LED screen overhead, live music stages, and the SlotZilla zip line. Classic old Vegas.

timeline.title: Downtown Nightlife
timeline.description: Explore more of Downtown Vegas — Container Park, the Mob Museum area, or the Circa casino floor. Wind down early — long drive to Grand Canyon tomorrow.
